From:           Justin Poole
To:             "Murrell, Robert"; "Davis, James"

Bob/Mike,

We noticed an error due to a typo in the email when we were going back validating the
information across the fleet. The fee cap value for the exemption request (L-2026-LLE-0023)
should have been $38,000 not $23,000. I’ve updated the table below. Apologize for any

Justin C. Poole
Sr. Project Manager

From: Justin Poole
Sent: Tuesday, September 29, 2026 11:36 AM
To: 'Murrell, Robert' <Bob.Murrell@nexteraenergy.com>; 'Davis, James' <james.davis@fpl.com>
Cc: Ilka Berrios <Ilka.Berrios@nrc.gov>; Brent Ballard <Brent.Ballard@nrc.gov>
Subject: RE: Duane Arnold Energy Center - Fixed Fee Caps for Ongoing Licensing Actions


Bob/Mike,

In accordance with 10 CFR 170.33, which becomes effective on October 1, 2026, this
communication establishes the fixed cap on service fees (fixed fee cap) for NextEra Energy
Duane Arnold, LLC for the Duane Arnold Energy Center licensing actions listed in the table
below. The table lists the fixed fee caps for the NRC’s review of ongoing licensing actions that
have been accepted for review that will be within the scope of 10 CFR 170.33. Fixed fee caps for
other licensing actions, such as those currently under acceptance review, will be
communicated by separate correspondence. The NRC considered various factors when
establishing these fixed fee caps, such as the quality and complexity of the application,
technology type, and any pre-application engagement. The Professional Hourly Rate
established at 10 CFR 170.20(a) applies to these licensing actions.

Application Date Acceptance               EPID                                                  Fixed Fee
(ADAMS           Date                                                                           Cap
Accession No.)
 5/12/2026       6/11/2026                L-2026-LLL-0011, Request for Approval of              $48,000.00
(ML26132A285)                             Glass Panel Simulation Facility
  5/12/2026          6/11/2026       L-2026-LLE-0023, Request Exemption to 10        $38,000.00
(ML26132A285)                       CFR 55.46(c) to Support Use of Glass Panel
                                    Simulator

The fixed fee cap represents the maximum amount that the NRC may charge for service fees for
each of the requested licensing actions following acceptance of the complete application. The
fixed fee cap will not be increased except in instances of applicant failure, as defined in 10 CFR
170.3. If applicant failure occurs, the NRC will notify NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC, in
writing of the new fixed fee cap, which will be set at the lowest practicable amount determined
by the NRC to account for the applicant failure and complete the review.

For each licensing action, the NRC will track service fees against the fixed fee cap beginning on
the acceptance date listed above.  

Disputes associated with a fixed fee cap must be submitted in accordance with 10 CFR 15.31
and 170.33(f) and NRC Form 529 procedures. If you have any questions, please contact me.

Justin C. Poole
Sr. Project Manager
Palisades, Crane, Duane Arnold Restart
NRR/DLP-1/ORLB 3
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
(301)415-2048
